title: Proteasome alpha6 Subunit Negatively Regulates the JAK/STAT Pathway and Blood Cell Activation in Drosophila melanogaster.
authors: Jarvela-Stolting, Mirva; Vesala, Laura; Maasdorp, Matthew K; Ciantar, Joanna; Ramet, Mika; Valanne, Susanna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇蛋白酶体亚基对JAK/STAT信号通路的调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: JAK/STAT signaling regulates central biological functions such as development, cell differentiation and immune responses. In Drosophila, misregulated JAK/STAT signaling in blood cells (hemocytes) induces their aberrant activation. Using mass spectrometry to analyze proteins associated with a negative regulator of the JAK/STAT pathway, and by performing a genome-wide RNAi screen, we identified several components of the proteasome complex as negative regulators of JAK/STAT signaling in Drosophila. A selected proteasome component, Prosalpha6, was studied further. In S2 cells, Prosalpha6 silencing decreased the amount of the known negative regulator of the pathway, ET, leading to enhanced expression of a JAK/STAT pathway reporter gene. Silencing of Prosalpha6 in vivo resulted in activation of the JAK/STAT pathway, leading to the formation of lamellocytes, a specific hemocyte type indicative of hemocyte activation. This hemocyte phenotype could be partially rescued by simultaneous knockdown of either the Drosophila STAT transcription factor, or MAPKK in the JNK-pathway. Our results suggest a role for the proteasome complex components in the JAK/STAT pathway in Drosophila blood cells both in vitro and in vivo.
abstract_zh: JAK/STAT信号传导调控着发育、细胞分化和免疫反应等核心生物功能。在果蝇中，血细胞（hemocytes）中JAK/STAT信号传导的失调会诱导其异常激活。通过使用质谱分析JAK/STAT通路负调控因子相关的蛋白质，并进行全基因组RNAi筛选，我们鉴定了蛋白酶体复合物的几个组分作为果蝇JAK/STAT信号传导的负调控因子。我们进一步研究了选定的蛋白酶体组分Prosalpha6。在S2细胞中，Prosalpha6的沉默减少了该通路已知负调控因子ET的量，导致JAK/STAT通路报告基因表达增强。在体内沉默Prosalpha6导致JAK/STAT通路激活，进而形成片状细胞（lamellocytes），这是一种指示血细胞激活的特异性血细胞类型。这种血细胞表型可以通过同时敲低果蝇STAT转录因子或JNK通路中的MAPKK来部分挽救。我们的结果表明，蛋白酶体复合物组分在果蝇血细胞的JAK/STAT通路中，在体外和体内均发挥作用。
